job.title: Software Engineer-1
job.pay_full: $152,405 – $179,300 a year base salary (excluding equity and bonus); varies by location

details.about: This engineer joins the Money Movement team in Coinbase's Developer product group, building the infrastructure behind global payments. The developer platform brings payments, trading, wallets and stablecoins together through one onboarding flow and self-service APIs; the team builds backend systems for stablecoin-based pay-ins, payouts, deposits and withdrawals.
duties: Own key projects end to end as the Directly Responsible Individual, from system design to production deployment
Build backend systems, infrastructure and internal and external APIs that let businesses embed stablecoin payments
Work with Product, Design, Infrastructure and Compliance to turn requirements into scalable solutions
Improve performance, scalability and reliability across distributed systems
Support engineering quality through code reviews and architectural best practices
needs: 2+ years of software engineering experience building and operating backend systems, ideally in fintech, payments or crypto
Proficiency in backend languages (e.g. Go, Java) and cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS, GCP), with hands-on distributed systems and API design
A track record as DRI on technical projects, from system design through production
Experience integrating with or building on blockchain or crypto technologies such as stablecoins, on-chain payments or smart contract platforms (e.g. Ethereum, Solana, Base)
Ability to write technical design documents and explain architecture trade-offs
Responsible use of generative AI tools with human oversight
details.benefits: Annual base salary $152,405 – $179,300 (excluding equity and bonus); base salary varies by location. Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)).
notes: Remote-first, not remote-only: teams meet quarterly for in-person working sessions
Candidates may submit up to 3 applications in a 6-month period
Accommodations are available for candidates with disabilities
